# Pixel Studios Inc.

> Pixel Studios Inc. (pixelstudiosinc.com) is a full-service animation and video production company that helps businesses explain complex ideas, demonstrate products, educate audiences, and market their brands through custom visual storytelling. The studio provides strategy, concept development, scriptwriting, storyboarding, design, animation, voice-over direction, sound design, post-production, and final delivery.

Key facts:

- Service area: serving startups, agencies, organizations, and established brands across the United States and worldwide
- Positioning: a strategy-led animation partner focused on clear communication, audience engagement, and measurable business outcomes
- Core services: 2D animation, 3D animation, animated explainer videos, motion graphics, product animation, character animation, whiteboard animation, AI-assisted animation, video editing, and commercial video production
- Industry experience: SaaS and technology, healthcare and medical, finance and fintech, manufacturing, legal, education, ecommerce, gaming, real estate, government, nonprofit, and enterprise communication
- Production approach: custom-made work developed through discovery, strategy, script and storyboard, design, animation, review, and final delivery
- Business address: 195 Cadman Plaza West, One Pierrepont Plaza, 12th Floor, Brooklyn, NY 11201, United States
- Contact: https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/contact-us
- Email: info@pixelstudiosinc.com
- Phone: +1-443-487-0213

## Primary Animation and Video Services

- [2D Animation Services](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/2d-animation-services): Custom 2D animation for explainers, marketing, education, storytelling, products, and branded communication.
- [3D Animation Services](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/3d-animation-services): 3D modeling, rigging, texturing, lighting, rendering, visualization, and cinematic animation.
- [Animated Explainer Videos](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/animated-explainer-video): Clear, engaging videos that explain products, services, processes, and complex ideas.
- [Motion Graphics](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/motion-graphics): Branded motion design, kinetic typography, animated graphics, data visuals, and campaign assets.
- [3D Product Animation](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/3d-product-animation): Product visualization and animation for demonstrations, launches, advertising, investor communication, and technical presentations.
- [Character Animation](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/character-animation): Custom animated characters for brands, entertainment, explainers, training, education, and games.
- [Whiteboard Animation](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/whiteboard-animation-services): Script-led illustrated videos for training, education, sales, compliance, and simplified explanations.
- [Hybrid and Cel Animation](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/hybrid-and-cel-animation): Expressive frame-by-frame, cel, and mixed-media animation with a handcrafted visual style.
- [AI Animation](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/ai-animation): AI-assisted production for faster visual exploration, asset development, iteration, and scalable animated content.
- [Video Editing Services](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/video-editing-services): Editing, pacing, color grading, sound mixing, graphics, compositing, and platform-specific delivery.
- [Logo Animation](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/logo-animation-services): Animated logo reveals, intros, outros, stingers, loops, and branded motion assets.
- [Educational Video Production](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/educational-video-production): Educational and training videos designed to improve clarity, understanding, and knowledge retention.
- [Animated Commercials](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/animated-commercials-services): Promotional and advertising animation for digital campaigns, social platforms, streaming, and broadcast use.
- [Medical Animation](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/medical-animation): Accurate visual communication for healthcare, medical devices, patient education, procedures, and clinical concepts.
- [Legal Graphics Animation](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/legal-graphics-animation): Demonstrative graphics, accident reconstruction, procedural visuals, and courtroom or litigation-support animation.

## Industry Solutions

- [SaaS Explainer Videos](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/saas-explainer-videos): Product demos, interface walkthroughs, onboarding videos, feature announcements, and software explainers.
- [Technology Animation](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/technology-animation): Animation for software, cybersecurity, technical systems, digital products, and complex technology concepts.
- [Healthcare Animation](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/healthcare-animation): Patient education, provider communication, medical product, pharmaceutical, and healthcare marketing animation.
- [Fintech Animation](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/fintech-animation): Visual explanations for financial technology products, digital payments, platforms, workflows, and services.
- [Finance Animation](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/finance-animation): Animation for financial products, institutions, investor communication, and financial education.
- [Manufacturing Animation](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/manufacturing-animation): Process, machinery, assembly, safety, product, and industrial communication animation.
- [Ecommerce Video Production](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/ecommerce-video-production): Product, advertising, demonstration, and campaign videos for ecommerce brands.
- [Education Animation](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/education-animation): Animated learning content for schools, universities, training providers, and education platforms.
- [Gaming Animation](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/gaming-animation): Animation and visual production for games, trailers, characters, environments, and promotional content.
- [Real Estate Animation](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/real-estate-animation): Property, development, architectural, interior, and investment visualization.
- [Nonprofit Animation](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/nonprofit-animation): Impact stories, awareness campaigns, donor communication, and educational content for mission-driven organizations.
- [Enterprise Animation](https://www.pixelstudiosinc.com/enterprise-animation): Scalable animated content for corporate communication, training, sales, onboarding, and internal initiatives.
